svg.title: Your Cloudflare data, in DuckDB.
svg.desc: Cloudflare's Durable Objects, D1, and Analytics Engine connect through the Grainlift ADBC driver using vgi-rpc over HTTPS. Apache Arrow results arrive in DuckDB. Query in a browser with Haybarn, Cupola, and WebAssembly, or connect natively from a terminal or Python.
